parameters.help_en: The ID of the intelligent tagging job to query. You can obtain this ID from the response parameters of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163486.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的智能标签作业ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163486.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
Additional request parameters, represented as a JSON string. Example: `{"labelResultType":"auto"}`. The `labelResultType` parameter is of the String type. Valid values:

auto: Machine tagging results.

hmi: Human-machine interaction results
parameters.help_zh:
额外的请求参数，使用JSON字符串表示，例如：`{"labelResultType":"auto"}`。其中，`labelResultType`为String类型，可取值：

auto：机器打标结果

hmi：人机协同结果
parameters.name: params

JobStatus.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

Success: The job is processed.

Fail: The job failed.

Processing: The job is being processed.

Submitted: The job is submitted and waiting to be processed
JobStatus.description_zh:
任务状态，可取值：

Success：处理成功。

Fail：处理失败。

Processing：处理中。

Submitted：已提交等待处理

Result.description_en: The array of analysis result objects

items.description_en: The details of the analysis result objects
items.description_zh: 分析结果对象数组详细信息

Data.description_en: The specific data of the analysis result, represented as a JSON character string. The data structures for different Type values are described in the Result parameter description section below
Data.description_zh: 分析结果的具体数据，以JSON字符串表示。不同Type的数据结构见下文Result参数说明

Type.description_en:
The type of the analysis result.

Analysis result types for Tagging 1.0:

    - TextLabel: Text tags
    - VideoLabel: Video tags
    - ASR: Raw speech recognition results (not returned by default)
    - OCR: Raw optical character recognition (OCR) results (not returned by default)
    - Process: Link to the raw algorithm result JSON file (not returned by default). For the JSON structure, see Supplementary description.
Analysis result types for Tagging 2.0:

    - CPVLabel (human-machine)
    - Meta: Information such as video title (not returned by default)
Analysis result types for Tagging 2.0-custom:

    - CPVLabel (human-machine)
    - Meta: Information such as video title (not returned by default)
Type.description_zh:
分析结果的类型。

标签1.0分析结果类型：

    - TextLabel：文本标签
    - VideoLabel：视频标签
    - ASR：语音识别原始结果（默认不返回）
    - OCR：文字识别原始结果（默认不返回）
    - Process:  算法原始结果JSON文件链接（默认不返回），JSON结构请参见补充说明
标签2.0分析结果类型：

    - CPVLabel（人机）
    - Meta：视频标题等信息（默认不返回）
标签2.0-custom分析结果类型：

    - CPVLabel（人机）
    - Meta：视频标题等信息（默认不返回）

UserData.description_en: The information passed through when a callback is sent by using MNS. For the message format, see Callback message format definition below
UserData.description_zh: 通过MNS回调时透传回来的信息。消息格式请参见下文回调消息格式定义
